summary: Executed Phase 144H's own Future Chapter Recommendation #4 (reconcile roadmap-tracking sources). Defined the purpose/authority/owner/update mechanism/synchronization relationship for every strategic artifact (PROJECT_STATUS.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/V0_2_AUTONOMY_ROADMAP.md, Architecture Status, canonical phase reports), establishing PROJECT_STATUS.md's Current Phase section as the sole authoritative live-status source. Audited every strategic artifact against the actual repository state and independently confirmed the three-way roadmap-tracking disagreement 144H first found (pcae roadmap current reports phase 69P; docs/ROADMAP.md claimed 90 phases complete/90B/June 2026; docs/V0_2_AUTONOMY_ROADMAP.md's Recommended Next Phase section claimed 107B when it had been completed roughly 35 chapters earlier as part of the 107A-107E chapter), plus one new finding of its own: pcae architecture-status inspect classifies Phase 144H as 'In Progress' even though PROJECT_STATUS.md's own text for 144H says '(completed...)' -- a Non-Blocking generator/display inconsistency, disclosed but not repaired (a src/ change, outside this phase's documentation-only, zone-restricted scope). Corrected docs/ROADMAP.md's Current State section and docs/V0_2_AUTONOMY_ROADMAP.md's Recommended Next Phase section to no longer assert stale current-state claims, adding dated superseded-plan banners above both documents' now-historical phase-sequence tables (90-96 series and 107-115 series respectively) without deleting or rewording any of their original content. Confirmed both documents' durable principle-level content (docs/ROADMAP.md's ten Roadmap Principles and Long-Term Runtime Vision; docs/V0_2_AUTONOMY_ROADMAP.md's six-level autonomy ladder, Level-3 target, and 17 Hard No-Go Conditions) remains valid and unchanged, consistent with 144H's own finding that the project's actual history honored these principles even while diverging from the literal phase-ID sequence. Produced a Strategic Consistency Matrix (artifact, purpose, authority, owner, update mechanism, sync status, historical-or-current, dependencies, confidence) any future phase can consult instead of re-deriving artifact authority from scratch, and classified remaining documentation debt (Blocking: the two corrected roadmap sections, now resolved; Non-Blocking/Deferred: the Architecture Status generator gap, the .pcae/strategic-lineage.json lineage-recording gap since phase 69P, an 'operational readiness' terminology gap between phase reports and roadmap documents). Did not modify .pcae/strategic-lineage.json (a governance-lineage change requiring its own governed decision-recording workflow, outside this phase's own No-Go-forbidden scope) and did not re-derive the v0.2 execution-capability gap analysis against today's larger governed-decision-making surface (144H's own recommendation #3, explicitly deferred to a future dedicated phase). No historical phase report or pre-existing PROJECT_STATUS.md entry was rewritten. Runtime confirmed unchanged (Observed/observe/unavailable) via pcae runtime inspect at phase start and close. This phase's recommendation does not authorize any later phase. See docs/PHASE_144I_STRATEGIC_ROADMAP_AND_STATUS_SYNCHRONIZATION.md.
